title: do and make
summary: **do** — действие, работа, занятия (do homework, do the shopping); **make** — создавать, производить (make a cake) и устойчивые сочетания (make a mistake, make a phone call).
ru:
## do — делать (действие, занятие)
**Do** — общий глагол для действий и дел. Русское «делать» часто переводится как **do**.
> What are you **doing** this evening? — Что ты делаешь сегодня вечером?
> 'Shall I open the window?' 'No, I'll **do** it.' — Я сам.
> Julia **does** the same thing every day. — Юлия каждый день делает одно и то же.
> What do you **do**? — I work in a bank. — Кем ты работаешь?

## make — создавать, производить
**Make** — когда что-то создаём или производим.
> She's **making** coffee. — Она варит кофе.
> He has **made** a cake. — Он испёк торт.
> They **make** umbrellas. — Они делают зонты.
> It was **made** in France. — Это сделано во Франции.

## Сравните
> I **did** a lot of things yesterday. I cleaned my room, wrote some letters and **made** a cake.
> What do you **do** in your free time? — I **make** clothes. (шью одежду)

## Устойчивые сочетания с do
- **do** homework, exercises, housework, an exam / a test, a course
- **do** a favour (оказать услугу): Could you **do me a favour**?
- **do** the shopping, the washing, the washing-up, the ironing, the cooking
> Have the children **done** their homework? — Дети сделали уроки?
> I hate **doing housework**. — Ненавижу домашние дела.

## Устойчивые сочетания с make
- **make** a mistake (ошибиться), an appointment (записаться), a phone call (позвонить), a list (составить список), a noise (шуметь), a bed (застелить постель)
> I'm sorry, I **made a mistake**. — Простите, я ошибся.
> I must **make an appointment** to see the doctor. — Надо записаться к врачу.
> Don't **make** a noise! — Не шумите!

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I make my homework.~~ → I **do** my homework.
- ~~She did a mistake.~~ → She **made** a mistake.
- ~~What are you making this evening?~~ → What are you **doing**?
- ~~Can you make me a favour?~~ → Can you **do** me a favour?
en:
## do — actions and activities
**Do** is a general word for actions and jobs.
> What are you **doing** this evening?
> 'Shall I open the window?' 'No, I'll **do** it.'
> Julia **does** the same thing every day.
> What do you **do**? — I work in a bank. (= What's your job?)

## make — create or produce
> She's **making** coffee.
> He has **made** a cake.
> They **make** umbrellas.
> It was **made** in France.

## Compare
> I **did** a lot of things yesterday. I cleaned my room, wrote some letters and **made** a cake.
> What do you **do** in your free time? — I **make** clothes.

## Expressions with do
- **do** homework, exercises, housework, an exam / a test, a course
- **do** a favour: Could you **do me a favour**?
- **do** the shopping, the washing, the washing-up, the ironing, the cooking
> Have the children **done** their homework?
> I hate **doing housework**.

## Expressions with make
- **make** a mistake, an appointment, a phone call, a list, a noise, a bed
> I'm sorry, I **made a mistake**.
> I must **make an appointment** to see the doctor.
> Don't **make** a noise!

## Common mistakes
- ~~I make my homework.~~ → I **do** my homework.
- ~~She did a mistake.~~ → She **made** a mistake.
- ~~Can you make me a favour?~~ → Can you **do** me a favour?
structure:
## Сочетания
| do | make |
|---|---|
| do homework | make a mistake |
| do exercises | make a phone call |
| do housework | make an appointment |
| do an exam / a test | make a list |
| do a course | make a noise |
| do a favour | make a bed |
| do the shopping / washing / ironing / cooking | make food and drinks: make coffee, make a cake |

## Формы
| Глагол | Present | Past | Participle |
|---|---|---|---|
| do | do / does | did | done |
| make | make / makes | made | made |

## Вопрос и отрицание
> **Do** you **do** sport? · What **did** you **do**? · He **doesn't make** mistakes.

## Памятка
> **do** — делать дела и занятия; **make** — создавать и производить.
> Выражения нужно **запоминать**: do homework, make a mistake.

exercises.title: do или make?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **do / does / did / done** или **make / makes / made**.

items.text: I usually {{do}} my homework after dinner.
She {{made}} a cake for my birthday.
I must {{make}} an appointment with the dentist.
He is {{doing|taking}} his driving test next week.
Let's {{make}} a list of things to buy.
My brother never {{makes}} his bed in the morning.

items.prompt: (she / a cake / for the party) — прошлое
answers: She made a cake for the party.
We don't make any noise at night.

We don't make a noise at night.
We don't make noise at night.
Tom is doing his homework now.

answers: Can you do me a favour?
